description: This file defines a module for generating chart themes that are aware of dark mode settings. It includes functions to retrieve CSS variables, convert hex colors to RGBA, and assemble a theme object with color tokens sourced from CSS variables or fallback theme tokens.

methods.name: getCssVar
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from :root; returns fallback if unavailable or on error.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color to an RGBA string with specified alpha, with fallback on failure.
